screening_decisions.reason: Randomized double-blind trial of DDAVP vs placebo in elective aortic surgery assessing blood loss/transfusion; meets RCT, perioperative DDAVP criteria.
Double-blind randomized study in total hip replacement comparing DDAVP vs placebo with blood loss outcomes; fits inclusion.
Meta-analysis of RCTs, not a primary randomized trial.
Randomized trial after CPB comparing DDAVP (one/two doses) vs aprotinin vs no treatment with bleeding/transfusion endpoints; active comparator allowed.
Prospective randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in CABG patients on aspirin; perioperative DDAVP with bleeding outcomes.
Randomized study in orthognathic surgery; DDAVP vs no DDAVP; perioperative blood loss/hematocrit outcomes. Randomization stated though blinding not specified.
Prospective double-blind placebo-controlled RCT in elective cardiac surgery (abnormal hemoSTATUS subgroup) assessing blood loss and transfusion; eligible.

Perioperative DDAVP vs saline after hydroxyethyl starch; evaluates vWF:RCoF. Randomization not explicit and outcomes are surrogate, but perioperative comparator trial likely RCT; include conservatively.
Guideline summary on transfusion thresholds; not a DDAVP randomized trial.
Double-blind RCT in total hip replacement under dextran therapy; DDAVP vs placebo with blood loss/transfusion endpoints.
Double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial post-CPB in patients with excessive bleeding; perioperative DDAVP; appropriate.
Valvular heart surgery study comparing DDAVP vs control with blood loss/transfusion outcomes; randomization not explicit; include conservatively.
Randomized controlled trial in cirrhotic patients undergoing dental extraction comparing intranasal DDAVP vs transfusion; invasive procedure; acquired (non-inherited) coagulopathy.
Double-blind randomized trial in total joint arthroplasty comparing DDAVP vs placebo; perioperative bleeding/transfusion outcomes.
Small study in aspirin-treated cholecystectomy patients; comparator group without DDAVP; randomization not stated but perioperative DDAVP comparator trial; include conservatively.
Randomized clinical trial in functional endoscopic sinus surgery comparing DDAVP vs saline; assesses intraoperative blood loss and field quality.
Randomized double-blind controlled trial in Harrington rod spinal fusion; DDAVP vs placebo with blood loss/transfusion outcomes.
Double-blind randomized trial in CABG patients pretreated with aspirin; DDAVP vs placebo; perioperative transfusion endpoints.
Double-blind randomized trial comparing aprotinin vs desmopressin vs placebo in CPB; bleeding/transfusion outcomes; active comparator allowed.
Randomized double-blind trial after CABG evaluating DDAVP vs placebo (hemodynamic safety primary); perioperative setting with blood loss reported; eligible.
Double-blind randomized trial in CPB patients assessing DDAVP vs placebo with bleeding and transfusion outcomes.
Double-blind study in spinal fusion for neuromuscular scoliosis comparing DDAVP vs placebo; perioperative blood loss measured; likely RCT.
Randomized double-blind trial in routine CABG; DDAVP vs placebo; bleeding/transfusion outcomes.
Systematic review/meta-analysis of transfusion strategies unrelated to DDAVP intervention; not a primary DDAVP RCT.
Methodological paper on small-study effects; not a clinical DDAVP randomized trial.

Randomized, blinded study in elective CABG comparing DDAVP (single/repeat) vs placebo administered after CPB; perioperative surgical population without inherited bleeding disorders; outcomes include blood loss and transfusion.
Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial in primary CABG with DDAVP after CPB; perioperative setting; evaluates blood loss and transfusion.
Double-blind RCT in cardiac operations, DDAVP vs placebo; perioperative; assesses bleeding and replacement volume.
Letter/commentary text on pediatric sedation/analgesia for IV access; not an RCT of DDAVP in perioperative/invasive bleeding context.
Randomized, blinded comparison of DDAVP vs placebo after CPB in pediatric cardiac surgery; perioperative setting; assesses blood loss and transfusion.
Part of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in CABG; DDAVP vs vehicle after CPB; includes outcomes on bleeding time and postoperative blood loss.
Retrospective cohort of patients declining transfusion; no DDAVP intervention; not an RCT; not a DDAVP perioperative trial.
Randomized trial around diagnostic catheterization but outcome is thrombosis prevention; not evaluating perioperative blood loss or transfusion; off-outcome for this review.
Double-blind RCT of pre-biopsy subcutaneous DDAVP vs placebo in percutaneous kidney biopsy (invasive procedure); evaluates bleeding complications and hematoma size.
Guideline on inherited bleeding disorder (VWD); not an RCT; population outside review scope (focus excludes inherited bleeding disorders).
Double-blind randomized clinical trial of DDAVP vs placebo in major scoliosis surgery; perioperative administration; assesses blood loss and coagulation.
Randomized double-blind three-arm trial (two DDAVP doses vs placebo) in total hip arthroplasty; perioperative; assesses total blood loss and transfusion requirements.

Perioperative DDAVP in cardiac surgery targeting aspirin-induced platelet dysfunction (acquired, not inherited); title/abstract suggests interventional comparison to reduce blood loss/transfusions though randomization not explicitly stated; include conservatively for later verification.
Narrative review of DDAVP efficacy/safety across conditions; not an RCT of perioperative administration.
News/commentary summarizing trial findings; not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Review on transfusion reactions; not about perioperative DDAVP RCTs.
Placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial of preoperative DDAVP infusion in burn debridement/grafting; evaluates perioperative blood loss.
Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial in elective cardiac surgery with CPB; assesses postoperative blood loss and blood product use.
Survey of RBC utilization; no DDAVP intervention; not an RCT.
Observational database analysis of CABG bleeding/reoperation; no DDAVP intervention; not an RCT.
Guideline on platelet transfusions; not a DDAVP perioperative RCT.

Multicenter randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP vs placebo in actively bleeding post-cardiac surgery patients pre-treated with tranexamic acid; evaluates RBC transfusion and blood loss.
Methodological paper on funnel plot asymmetry; not a DDAVP perioperative RCT.
Mechanistic review; not an RCT; not perioperative trial.

Randomized, prospective, double-blind clinical trial of DDAVP vs placebo at initiation of flap reconstructive surgery; assesses intraoperative blood loss and transfusions in hemostatically normal patients.
Randomized, double-blind CABG trial comparing DDAVP vs placebo given post-CPB; perioperative setting with transfusion outcomes; no inherited bleeding disorders.
Case/ex vivo study in Bernard–Soulier syndrome (inherited bleeding disorder), not perioperative and not an RCT.
Guideline on hereditary bleeding disorders; not an original randomized trial and outside perioperative RCT scope.
Nonrandomized observational comparison (DDAVP given due to bleeding tendency) of platelet reactivity in CABG; not an RCT.
Practice guideline update; not an original randomized controlled trial.
Meta-analysis/secondary research of DDAVP trials; not an individual perioperative RCT.
Meta-analysis of prophylactic drugs (including DDAVP); not an original RCT.
Narrative review of alternatives to platelet transfusion; not an RCT of DDAVP in perioperative context.

Prospective single-blind comparative trial in total knee replacement comparing tranexamic acid vs desmopressin (active comparator) perioperatively; randomization not explicit but design suggests controlled comparison; included conservatively.
Prospective series of uremic patients undergoing emergent invasive procedures with DDAVP but no control/comparator; not an RCT.
Randomized uremic patient study measuring platelet function before dialysis; not perioperative/invasive-procedure RCT targeting surgical transfusion outcomes.
Before–after screening study with PFA-100 in neurosurgery; DDAVP use not randomized; not an RCT.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind trial in children undergoing cardiac surgery comparing DDAVP vs placebo perioperatively.
Randomized, placebo-controlled three-arm trial in total knee replacement including a DDAVP arm; perioperative context with transfusion outcomes.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT in elective cardiac surgery assessing blood loss/transfusion; perioperative DDAVP vs placebo.
Pharmacokinetic/haematologic effects study in humans; not perioperative and not an RCT of surgical/invasive procedures.
Randomized, controlled, double-blind trial in elective hepatectomy comparing DDAVP vs saline; perioperative outcomes (blood loss/transfusion).
Before–after PFA-100 screening in neurosurgery; DDAVP given nonrandomly; not an RCT.
Double-blind randomized trial in cardiac surgery with arms including desmopressin and/or tranexamic acid; perioperative blood loss/transfusion outcomes.
Double-blind, prospective, randomized trial in complex cardiac operations comparing intraoperative DDAVP vs placebo.
Randomized trial in adult cardiopulmonary bypass patients comparing DDAVP vs placebo; perioperative blood loss/transfusion outcomes.
Randomized, double-blind CABG study of DDAVP vs placebo evaluating hemodynamics and postoperative blood loss.
Randomized comparison of DDAVP alone vs DDAVP plus tranexamic acid; both arms receive DDAVP, so it does not compare DDAVP to placebo/active comparator as required.
Systematic review/meta-analysis of tranexamic acid; not an original DDAVP RCT.
Consensus/recommendations on platelet function testing in neurointerventional procedures; not an RCT of DDAVP.
Narrative review of desmopressin across conditions; not a randomized controlled trial of perioperative use with bleeding/transfusion outcomes.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of perioperative desmopressin in CABG patients (on antiplatelet therapy), assessing bleeding and transfusion-related variables.
Nonrandomized comparison/historical controls; does not meet RCT design criterion.
Methods/guidance document; not a clinical randomized trial of perioperative desmopressin.
Systematic review of biopsy technique; no perioperative desmopressin RCT or transfusion outcomes.
Case reports/series on adverse effects; not an RCT and not focused on perioperative bleeding/transfusion outcomes.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in valvular surgery; perioperative blood loss and transfusion assessed.
Meta-analysis across multiple drugs; not a primary RCT of desmopressin.
Double-blind randomized placebo-controlled perioperative desmopressin trial in aortic valve replacement with bleeding outcomes reported.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial in vascular surgery assessing perioperative blood loss and transfusion.
Prospective, double-blind randomized controlled trial in spinal fusion with perioperative blood loss outcomes.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind trial in congenital heart surgery; evaluates postoperative blood loss and transfusion.
Review focused on inherited bleeding disorder; not an RCT in surgical patients without inherited disorders.
Guideline document; not an RCT of perioperative desmopressin.
Prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled CABG trial; perioperative blood loss and transfusion outcomes assessed.
Phase II dose-escalation study without randomization/comparator; primary endpoints safety/dose; does not meet RCT criterion.
Randomized trial in elective CABG with intraoperative desmopressin vs control; evaluated blood loss and transfusion needs.
Meta-analysis of trials; not a primary randomized controlled trial for inclusion.
Double-blind, randomized, prospective trial of desmopressin vs placebo post-CPB with blood loss and transfusion outcomes.
Prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind CABG trial in patients pretreated with aspirin; relevant bleeding outcomes.
Nonrandomized sequential series in cosmetic surgery; outcome not focused on perioperative transfusion; does not meet RCT criterion.

Randomized, double-blind prospective study in surgical patients receiving perioperative desmopressin. Although primary outcomes are coagulation/fibrinolysis markers rather than explicit blood loss/transfusion, it is relevant to perioperative bleeding physiology; include conservatively.
Prospective randomized trial in CABG; reports perioperative blood loss and transfusion outcomes.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pediatric spinal fusion trial; assesses estimated blood loss and transfusions.
Meta-analysis across agents; not a primary RCT of desmopressin.
